result.instructions: Tools for Fireworks AI, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Fireworks AI data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run fireworks_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fireworks_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fireworks_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. fireworks_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fireworks_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get the Fireworks account record (display name, state, etc.). Control-plane: GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}.

account_id.description: Fireworks account id. Overrides FIREWORKS_ACCOUNT_ID for this call.

pageToken.description: Opaque page token from a previous response's nextPageToken.

tools.name: fireworks_create_dataset
tools.title: Create dataset
tools.description: Creates a dataset metadata record in Fireworks (additive; actual data is uploaded separately). Control-plane: POST /v1/accounts/{account_id}/datasets.

account_id.description: Fireworks account id. Overrides FIREWORKS_ACCOUNT_ID for this call.

datasetId.description: Id for the new dataset (the resource segment).

externalUrl.description: External source URL for the dataset data.

exampleCount.description: Number of examples in the dataset.

sourceDatasetId.description: Id of a source dataset to derive from.

filter.description: Filter applied when deriving from a source dataset.

tools.name: fireworks_delete_deployment
tools.title: Delete deployment
tools.description: DELETES (shuts down) a Fireworks deployment — stops serving that model and stops its billing. Destructive. Control-plane: DELETE /v1/accounts/{account_id}/deployments/{deployment_id}.

account_id.description: Fireworks account id. Overrides FIREWORKS_ACCOUNT_ID for this call.

deployment_id.description: Deployment id to delete (the resource segment).
